reviews.title: No luck
reviews.text: I was so excited about this app. I just got it today. But my first picture I took said my amethyst was an agate. I kept trying to get it to correct but it didn’t. I took a picture to contact support. The chat didn’t help but told me to click on the contact below which I did. I felt like I was having success finally. Uploaded the picture, expressed my concerns as I am a rock & gem collector and want to trust this app. I put in my email address which it would not take because it kept saying to enter a valid email address. I reentered it several times only to be told it’s invalid. It’s my only email address so it is valid. Now I can’t even contact customer service with my concern. I didn’t want to come here to write a review but that may be the only way to let them know the problems I personally experienced. I think the developers need to know. Disappointed & frustrated I canceled my subscription which canceled for the year not just the 7 day free trial. I was hopeful & excited with this app but sadly it didn’t work for me.  If this identification & invalid email address situation could be fixed I would try again because I liked the looks of the app. I just need to trust the information it’s giving me & have a way to contact customer service if needed.
